mainEntity.name: How much does ice machine repair cost in Parramatta?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most commercial ice machine repairs cost $200 to $900, plus a call-out fee of about $100 to $250. Gas leaks and compressors cost more and are quoted after testing. You get a fixed quote before we start, and that is the price you pay.

mainEntity.name: Why is my ice machine not making ice?

acceptedAnswer.text: The usual causes are a closed or blocked water supply, a clogged filter, a failed water inlet valve, a dirty condenser, a faulty bin sensor or a freezing fault in the sealed system. Check the water tap and the bin first, then call us if it is still not making ice.

mainEntity.name: Why is my ice machine making small, hollow or cloudy ice?

acceptedAnswer.text: Small or hollow cubes point to low water flow, a partly blocked filter or inlet valve, or a dirty condenser. Cloudy or soft ice often means scale or poor water quality. A clean and a filter change fixes many of these.

mainEntity.name: How often should a commercial ice machine be serviced?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most machines should be cleaned, descaled and sanitised regularly, and the water filter changed on schedule. Hard water and busy venues need more frequent visits. Ask us about a service visit when you book and we will quote it.

mainEntity.name: Why does my ice taste or smell bad?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ice picks up smells from dirty water lines, scale, a worn filter or food stored in the bin. A deep clean and sanitise, a new filter and a clean bin usually fix it. Ice is food, so do not serve ice that smells off.

mainEntity.name: Why is my ice machine leaking water?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common causes are a blocked drain, a loose or worn water line, a failed inlet valve or a bin or tray that is not sitting properly. We find where the water is coming from and repair that part.

mainEntity.name: Do you repair Ice-O-Matic, Hoshizaki and Scotsman ice machines?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We repair Ice-O-Matic, Hoshizaki, Scotsman and most other commercial ice machines, including cube, flake and under-bench models. Have the brand and model plate details ready when you book and we will bring the right parts.

mainEntity.name: Do you offer emergency ice machine repair in Parramatta?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. A broken ice machine is urgent for a bar or a busy kitchen. Book online or email us with the venue, the machine and what it is doing, and we confirm the fastest time we can get there.

mainEntity.name: Are you licensed to repair ice machines?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our work is carried out by licensed refrigeration mechanics (Lic #R38910) who are ARC licensed to handle refrigerant. We are independent, so we tell you plainly when a repair is not worth it.
